{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Trump told oil executives he would reverse climate progress and slash their taxes if they would give him $1 billion for his campaign.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Oil and gas lobbyists are drafting executive orders for Trump to sign on day one.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Trump wants to roll back the clean energy progress that President Biden has made.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Trump wants to gut the Environmental Protection Agency.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Trump wants to let polluters dump dangerous PFAS chemicals in our water.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"MAGA allies have tried 42 times to repeal the landmark climate law.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"If MAGA allies succeed in repealing the landmark climate law, they will eliminate tens of thousands of good-paying jobs.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"If MAGA allies succeed in repealing the landmark climate law, they will drive up home energy costs.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"If MAGA allies succeed in repealing the landmark climate law, they will sicken thousands of Americans with toxic pollution.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"If MAGA allies succeed in repealing the landmark climate law, they will cede the race for the future to China.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Across the world, there is massive new clean energy production and uptake.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"America must lead a new era that will redefine the global economy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
